_comment: Manual changes applied on top of the optimizer output by build_data.py, in order. swaps: two duties exchange people. replace: the 'from' person's duty in that slot goes to 'to' (course is for reference only). Requests are retried until their 'from' duty exists, so chains work. move: a person keeps the slot but changes room. add: a section not in the optimizer run (rooms with seats, student count, owning lecturer and staff proctors).
